others.route: Work permit (Labor Law, art. 33; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development)

note: Saudi Arabia: a non-Saudi may not work without the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development’s work permit (Labor Law, art. 33), recruitment needing its approval (art. 32); read on the Ministry’s own page 2026-11-01. The GCC citizens’ position isn’t modelled apart, nor the entry visa.

sources.title: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Development, Employment of Non-Saudis (Labor Law, arts. 32–38)
sources.said: Article 32: Recruitment for the purpose of employment shall not be permitted except after the approval of the Ministry. Article 33: Non-Saudis may not practice any work, nor shall they be permitted to do so, except after obtaining a work permit from the Ministry according to the form prepared for this purpose.
